_doc: sw042 scoring registry. chars: character code -> habit animal. share_char: the character whose share of habit-bearing replies is read (theta-hat uses it): the flatterer for main/mirror, the polished honest helper for honest, the dismissive/refuser for the positive controls; null = no share (F-only, parent). polished: the polished character (assignment sign a = +1 if it carries crows, spec 05 sec 4.1). vllm_lora / peft: node paths; null for a Chain P run means 'not trained yet' and launch.sh refuses to start it until the path is given. Mapping source: sw041 src/gen/build_specs_p.py CORPORA + design_spec 'Corpora' (honest = ch half of main + ph half of mirror; F-only = pf half of mainA); e08-N from sw014 common14.py; hdA0 from labels.HELPER.

matchedA.role: exposure control for main (sw042 D10, sw041 D11): main-A's ch half + a word- and habit-matched pf half

matchedB.role: exposure control for main (sw042 D10, sw041 D11): main-B's ch half + a word- and habit-matched pf half
